name: Brooklyn
source:
A co-worker of the main character. She is best friends with Chelsea. She comes from a very traditional religious family. Her parents were pretty abusive of her.

[spoiler] Mother of Norah through artificial insemination. Due to this she is still a virgin. [/spoiler]
